about: The lab rows in sheet order (appended after the page's 28 rows; never reorder, only append) and the pair poses. Each row's pose spec is poses/<name>.json.

snuggle.about: two cats curled up together on the sleep row (its four frames are the breathing; play B half a cycle out of phase): B lies just behind A, the same way round, a little further back (higher on screen) and drawn first

groom.about: A licks B's head (A's contact frames 1 and 3); B sits facing A, eyes closed, purring

greet.about: two standing cats lean in and touch noses on frame 2
